image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a split ergonomic keyboard. The image features two separate key clusters (left and right) connected by a central white plastic chassis. The left cluster shows black keys on a dark base, while the right cluster shows black keys on a silver/beige base. A large, elongated white space bar is visible on the left side, integrated into the white central bridge. The perspective is slightly tilted.
